nom: Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Cream

avis.texte: Great size container on this firming body cream! Makes my skin look less dry - and smoothes out skin for camera readiness. Made for sensitive skin.

This cream is lucious. It quickly absorbs and doesn't feel greasy at all. I can use it right before bed knowing that it won't get all over the sheets. The fragrance is so light I hardly notice it. avis.titre: Beware users with Nut allergies - sweet almond oil
avis.texte: I purchased this a few days ago, a life long cetaphil user with sensitive skin. Listed as hypoallergenic to remove common irritants, imagine my surprise when I developed a rash all over my face and neck due to the ingredient Sweet almond oil. Nut allergies and sensitivities are so common, why would it be added here and still listed as hypoallergenic.
